svg.title: DealFlow360 — architecture
svg.desc: DealFlow360: B2B sales operations · Next.js · Prisma · PostgreSQL · Gemini. Discount approvals, customer negotiation, fulfilment and billing often run in separate tools. DealFlow360 carries one quotation from first draft through approval, negotiation, warehouse fulfilment and billing in a single system.
